# Gregory M. Kapfhammer

> Associate Professor of Computer Science at Allegheny College. Researcher,
> educator, podcaster, and software developer focused on software testing,
> software engineering, and computer science education.

Gregory M. Kapfhammer studies automated techniques for software quality:
flaky test detection and repair, database testing, mutation testing,
regression testing, and test suite optimization. He is a co-host of
Software Engineering Radio and the creator of open-source developer tools
such as GatorGrader, Chasten, and SchemaAnalyst.

Aliases: gkapfham, Gregory Kapfhammer, Greg Kapfhammer

## Research Topics

- Software testing and verification
- Flaky test detection and repair
- Database testing and schema analysis
- Mutation testing for software and database systems
- Regression testing strategies
- Test suite reduction and prioritization
- Search-based software engineering
- Empirical software engineering
- Computer science education
- Algorithm analysis and data structures

- [Software Engineering Radio](https://se-radio.net/): Leading technical
  podcast for professional software developers
- [Host Profile](https://se-radio.net/team/gregory-kapfhammer/): Gregory

## Open-Source Projects

- [Chasten](https://github.com/AstuteSource/chasten): XPath-based Python
  linting tool for prose and code
- [GatorGrader](https://github.com/GatorEducator/gatorgrader): Automated
  assessment for source code and writing
- [GatorGrade](https://github.com/GatorEducator/gatorgrade): Python
  front-end for GatorGrader
- [SchemaAnalyst](https://github.com/schemaanalyst-team/schemaanalyst):
  Test data generation and mutation analysis for database schemas
- [Cellveyor](https://github.com/GatorEducator/cellveyor): Conveys
  reports from Google Sheets to GitHub

## Awards

- Thoburn Award for Excellence in Teaching (Allegheny College)
- ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award (ESEC/FSE 2003)
- Best Paper Award (GECCO 2010 SBSE Track)
- Best Presentation Award (SBST 2016)
- IEEE TCSE Distinguished Paper Award (ICST 2019)
